subject: UptimeRobot Monthly: Introducing response time and location-specific monitoring!
body:
UptimeRobot Monthly: Introducing response time and location-specific 
monitoring! 
We're excited to share our two newly launched and most requested features! 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/OXFTKR89wf3S0jXlrJ8w3A/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 


*Your UptimeRobot Monthly Update.*

Hi there! 👋

We're excited to share our two newly launched and most requested features, *Response 
Time and Location-Specific Monitoring*, an update on our Public Status 
Pages, and brand-new blogs and guides.
What's new on UptimeRobot? Introducing: Location-Specific Monitoring 

[image: location monitoring] 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/42L2L7638A9dwXXxrEp34Lkw/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg>Get 
real-time alerts when performance issues arise in specific regions! Our new 
Location-Specific Monitoring feature lets you track your site’s performance 
from four global regions and get region-based insights. Want to track 
multiple locations for the same monitor? Simply create a separate monitor 
for each region you want to cover.

What's in it for you:

   - *Keep your focus local:* Get alerts only when issues affect your local 
   area. 
   - *Improve user experience:* Quickly spot regional slowdowns or 
   connectivity issues. 

Learn more here. 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/Sur9ANQu7631wBCuIWn38ToQ/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 
Introducing: Response Time Monitoring 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/95YXXfmhZIxeZ1KxnE9h1g/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 

We are excited to release Response Time Monitoring! Now, you can set custom 
response time thresholds and get instant alerts when your site slows down. 

Plus, you can integrate alerts with over 16 popular services, allowing you 
to direct notifications exactly where you need them, so you'll *never miss 
a beat*. Learn more 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/95YXXfmhZIxeZ1KxnE9h1g/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg>
.
Update: Status Pages Available in 11 Languages 

You can now translate your Status Pages 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/ZkDwqUlqWW892Q59I892HzfQUw/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 
into 10 new languages: Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Hindi, 
Indonesian, Portuguese, Spanish, and Turkish. On top of English!

This feature gives your users a *localized experience*, letting them read 
status updates in their native language. And the best part? Switching 
languages is a breeze with our *seamless setup*.

These features are exclusively available in our Solo, Team, and Enterprise 
plans. Upgrade your account to unlock its full potential! 

To celebrate this release, we're offering a *20% discount on your first 
payment if you upgrade in the next 7 days*. 

Upgrade and save 20% 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/YdAElK4GB3vQRrQAyfvohA/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg>
------------------------------
Join our team 🚀 We’re hiring: Senior Product Manager 

Want to shape the future of uptime monitoring? We’re looking for a Senior 
Product Manager to help lead UptimeRobot’s next chapter. If you’re 
passionate about building impactful SaaS products and love working in a 
fast-paced, remote-first team, we’d love to hear from you 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/FDQhx9LSF2Xc3GHSnFb1BQ/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg>
.
------------------------------
New on the blog Cloud Infrastructure vs. Cloud Networking 

Cloud computing changed the game for how businesses manage and scale IT 
environments. But what’s the difference between cloud infrastructure and 
networking? Read our latest blog post 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/stQAe2Hz97H3EjY7763foU1A/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 
to learn how they interact and how to leverage them for your business.
Create an Effective Incident Response Plan 

No organization is safe from cyber threats, big or small. One data breach 
or ransomware attack can stop operations, causing financial loss and 
reputational damage. So, how can you prepare for the worst? Dive into our 
blog 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/nHsrYgTdnM9uanZELb7892Zw/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 
to learn how to respond and recover effectively with an Incident Response 
Plan that minimizes downtime and damage.
WMI Provider Host Explained 

Is the WMI Provider Host causing high CPU Spikes? While it's crucial for 
performance monitoring and updates in Windows, it can quickly drain 
resources if misconfigured. Explore our new guide 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/uJ8f5z5E3PshxWnJDQknYQ/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 
to uncover its functionality, troubleshooting tips, and importance in 
today’s IT environments.

And that's a wrap! 🌟 See you in next month's edition.

Have a great (up)time!
Nikol from UptimeRobot

subject: UptimeRobot Monthly: Introducing response time and location-specific monitoring!
body:
UptimeRobot Monthly: Introducing response time and location-specific 
monitoring! 
We're excited to share our two newly launched and most requested features! 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/OXFTKR89wf3S0jXlrJ8w3A/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 


*Your UptimeRobot Monthly Update.*

Hi there! 👋

We're excited to share our two newly launched and most requested features, *Response 
Time and Location-Specific Monitoring*, an update on our Public Status 
Pages, and brand-new blogs and guides.
What's new on UptimeRobot? Introducing: Location-Specific Monitoring 

[image: location monitoring] 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/42L2L7638A9dwXXxrEp34Lkw/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg>Get 
real-time alerts when performance issues arise in specific regions! Our new 
Location-Specific Monitoring feature lets you track your site’s performance 
from four global regions and get region-based insights. Want to track 
multiple locations for the same monitor? Simply create a separate monitor 
for each region you want to cover.

What's in it for you:

   - *Keep your focus local:* Get alerts only when issues affect your local 
   area. 
   - *Improve user experience:* Quickly spot regional slowdowns or 
   connectivity issues. 

Learn more here. 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/Sur9ANQu7631wBCuIWn38ToQ/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 
Introducing: Response Time Monitoring 
<https://sesweb.uptimerobot.com/l/9KCnH7yP6NKd28HpdZQzvQ/95YXXfmhZIxeZ1KxnE9h1g/OpNmdkvbwxY85Cj1NoFLtg> 

We are excited to release Response Time Monitoring! Now, you can set custom 
response time thresholds and get instant alerts when your site slows down.
